import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem sprint_development_0082 {u} {α : Type u} {l : List α} {n : ℕ} {m : ℕ} (h : n + m < l.length) :
  List.take n (List.drop m l) ++ List.drop (n + m) l = l := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem sprint_development_0082 {u} {α : Type u} {l : List α} {n : ℕ} {m : ℕ} (h : n + m < l.length) :
  List.take n (List.drop m l) ++ List.drop (n + m) l = l :=
  by
    rw [List.drop_take_append_drop]
    exact h
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0082 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0082 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0082

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0082
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0082
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
